context: Riku and Daichi talk about a Sapporo trip.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (発明/ハード/モード/フル/札幌) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 冬休み、札幌に行ってきたよ!
lines.en: I went to Sapporo over winter break!
lines.style: excited teen boy voice, bright warm eager delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ええなあ、札幌は雪がすごいやろ?
lines.en: Nice, Sapporo's got tons of snow, right?
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、雪まつりをフルで楽しんだよ。
lines.en: Yeah, I enjoyed the snow festival to the fullest.
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 寒さは、ハードやったやろ?
lines.en: The cold must've been hard, huh?
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ハードだったけど、最高だった!
lines.en: It was hard, but the best!
lines.style: animated teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: カメラの撮影モード、活躍したか?
lines.en: Did the camera's shooting modes shine?
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 夜景モードで、フルに撮ったよ。
lines.en: I shot fully with night mode.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 雪像って、まさに発明みたいやな!
lines.style: warm Kansai man voice, warm hearty closing delivery throughout
